integrity: The finite proof is supplied in full with two executable, standard-library-only reproductions and exact integral attaching-degree evidence. Only the described computation and mathematical deductions are claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies the ordinary independence complex of one precisely specified 24-vertex graph. It does not assert a theorem for all root-system or regular-polytope graphs or bibliographic priority over unindexed work.
title: The 24-cell graph independence complex is a mixed wedge of 31 two-spheres and 21 three-spheres
